scripts.admin: cd admin && npm run build && node scripts/bundle-edge.mjs
scripts.build: npm run admin && npm run css && go build -o bin/friendo ./cli/cmd/friendo/
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo serve
scripts.serve:open: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo serve --open-admin
scripts.export: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo export --mode static
scripts.deploy:local: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo deploy --api-url https://local.friendo.world
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && cd testsite && ../bin/friendo deploy --dry-run
